title: The storage a ring needs
body: mpsc_ring_storage_size(capacity) shall return the bytes mpsc_ring_init_into() needs for a ring of that capacity, the control block, the slots and the worst-case alignment slack of both included, and 0 when the capacity is below 2, not a power of two, or too large for size_t.
rationale: A caller sizing its own memory once at start (SSS-003) must get a size that works at any alignment of its buffer.
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c: 0 for 0, 1, 5 and 2^62; tests/ITs/integration_tests.c: the size round trip; init_into succeeds at every alignment with exactly that size.

title: A ring in the caller's memory
body: mpsc_ring_init_into(storage, storage_size, capacity) shall return an empty ring placed inside storage when storage is not NULL and storage_size is at least mpsc_ring_storage_size(capacity), whatever storage's alignment, and NULL otherwise; it shall never allocate, and mpsc_ring_destroy() on such a ring shall free nothing.
rationale: Static or arena memory taken once at start, nothing allocated later (SSS-003).
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c: the caller owns the storage, exact size at every alignment, undersized storage refused.

title: A ring in the library's memory
body: mpsc_ring_init(capacity) shall allocate exactly mpsc_ring_storage_size(capacity) zeroed bytes, build the ring inside them and own them, returning NULL (and freeing them) when the capacity is invalid, the allocation fails or the ring cannot be built; mpsc_ring_destroy() shall free them.
rationale: kyr_core creates each environment's ring this way at the queue's start (SSS-003).
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c: the allocation failure path through the seam; the suites create and destroy rings.

title: Capacity: a power of two, at least two
body: The capacity shall be a power of two and at least MPSC_RING_MIN_CAPACITY (2); a ring of capacity N shall accept N pushes from empty and refuse the next one.
rationale: One slot cannot tell 'published for pos' from 'free for pos + 1' (the sequence aliases), so a second producer could overwrite unread data; every slot of a valid ring is usable (SSS-003).
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c: 0, 1, 3 and 6 refused; a ring of 2 takes 2 and refuses the third.

title: Each job once, in the order of the claims
body: The values popped shall be the values pushed, each exactly once, in the order the producers' claims of enqueue_pos were made.
rationale: Exactly once is the customer's (SSS-001); the order is the claims' because each producer takes the next position.
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c (FIFO, wrap-around); tests/ITs/integration_tests.c (6 producers, a per-value check); tests/stress/stress_mt.c (16 producers, 8,000,000 values, a per-value bitmap).

title: A full ring refuses a push at once
body: mpsc_ring_push() shall return -1 and store nothing when the slot of the next position has not been freed by the consumer; on a NULL ring it shall return -1.
rationale: The submitter retries within its admission budget, then refuses the write (SSS-002, IRD-002).
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c: a push on a full ring returns -1 and the ring keeps its contents.

title: An empty ring refuses a pop at once
body: mpsc_ring_pop() shall return -1 and leave the caller's variable untouched when the next slot has not been published; a NULL output pointer shall discard the value popped; on a NULL ring it shall return -1.
rationale: The writer drains until the ring answers none (SSS-004, IRD-002).
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c: a pop on an empty ring returns -1; a pop with NULL output removes the value.

title: Each producer claims a distinct position
body: A producer shall store into the slot of position pos only after observing that slot's sequence equal to pos and winning a compare-and-swap of enqueue_pos from pos to pos + 1; no two producers shall ever claim the same position.
rationale: Two producers writing one slot is the failure the per-slot sequence exists to prevent (SSS-001, SSS-002, IRD-003).
criteria: An inspection of the claim loop; tests/UTs/unit_tests.c forces the lost-CAS branch through the push hook; the threaded suites under ThreadSanitizer.

title: The per-slot sequence protocol
body: Slot i shall start with sequence i; a sequence equal to pos shall mean free for position pos, pos + 1 published for pos, and pos + capacity read and free for the next lap; push shall set pos + 1 after its store, pop pos + capacity after its read.
rationale: The sequence is the only state the producers and the consumer share per slot (Vyukov's bounded queue); it tells free, published and freed apart without a lock (SSS-001, IRD-004).
criteria: An inspection of the protocol; tests/UTs/unit_tests.c (wrap-around over many laps, the minimum capacity).

title: The producer publishes with release
body: mpsc_ring_push() shall load the slot's sequence with acquire before it claims, store the value after the claim, and publish it with a release store of the sequence.
rationale: The acquire pairs with the consumer's release of the slot (the slot was read before it is reused); the release pairs with the consumer's acquire (the job and what the submitter wrote into it are visible, IRD-004).
criteria: An inspection of push against C11 7.17; the threaded suites and the stress under ThreadSanitizer report no race.

title: The consumer reads after acquire
body: mpsc_ring_pop() shall load the slot's sequence with acquire before it reads the value, and free the slot with a release store of the next lap's sequence after the read.
rationale: The acquire pairs with the producer's release; the release hands the slot to the producer of the next lap (IRD-004).
criteria: An inspection of pop against C11 7.17; the threaded suites under ThreadSanitizer report no race.

title: Progress: lock-free producers, a wait-free consumer
body: mpsc_ring_push() shall take no lock, make no system call and allocate nothing, and shall retry its claim only when another producer's claim succeeded or moved enqueue_pos past it (lock-free among producers); mpsc_ring_pop() and mpsc_ring_is_empty() shall finish in a bounded number of their own steps (wait-free).
rationale: No submitter waits on another; the writer never waits in a take (SSS-002, SSS-004).
criteria: An inspection of the claim loop and of pop: one loop whose retries follow another producer's success; straight-line pop.

title: The limit of progress: a stalled producer delays, never loses
body: A producer stalled between its claim and its publish shall delay the delivery of every later position until it publishes, the consumer answering empty meanwhile and the producers answering full once the ring wraps to the stalled slot; it shall never cause a value to be lost, duplicated or read before it is written. The ring is therefore not formally lock-free.
rationale: This is the customer's accepted limit (SSS-005) and the header's own statement; a reader who takes the ring for lock-free would misjudge its liveness.
criteria: An inspection of the window between the claim and the publish; tests/UTs/unit_tests.c steals a position without publishing it (the push hook).

title: Lock-free counters or no ring
body: mpsc_ring_init() and mpsc_ring_init_into() shall return NULL when enqueue_pos or a slot's sequence is not lock-free on the target (atomic_is_lock_free); a build defining MPSC_REQUIRE_ALWAYS_LOCK_FREE shall fail to compile on a target whose 64-bit atomics are not always lock-free.
rationale: A lock-backed atomic would put a lock on every hand-off (SRS-012, SSS-002).
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c: each counter reported lock-backed through the seam: NULL; the release build defines the switch.

title: Producers and consumer never share a cache line
body: enqueue_pos (the producers') and dequeue_pos (the consumer's) shall sit at least MPSC_CACHELINE (64) bytes apart, checked at compile time.
rationale: The producers' CAS traffic must not bounce the line the consumer writes on every take.
criteria: The _Static_assert of app/mpscring.c compiles in every profile.

title: Wrap-safe positions
body: Positions and sequences shall be 64-bit counters compared by their unsigned modular difference against UINT64_MAX / 2, never through a signed conversion; at 10^6 hand-offs a second they wrap after about 584,000 years.
rationale: Implementation-defined signed conversions would contradict the 'wrap-safe' claim; the box serves for months between restarts.
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c: wrap-around over many laps; an inspection of MPSC_SEQ_IS_NEGATIVE.

title: The emptiness check is the consumer's
body: mpsc_ring_is_empty() shall return 1 when the slot of the consumer's next position is not published and 0 otherwise, and 1 for a NULL ring; it shall be called from the consumer thread only, since it reads the consumer's plain position.
rationale: The writer learns whether to sleep from its own thread (SSS-004, IRD-003).
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c: empty after creation and after a drain, not empty after a push; tests/ITs/integration_tests.c.

title: Every call tolerates NULL
body: With a NULL ring, push and pop shall return -1, is_empty 1 and capacity 0; destroy shall accept NULL and a pointer to NULL; NULL shall be a value like any other, stored and popped.
rationale: A consumer's teardown runs on half-built state; a NULL payload is the caller's business (IRD-001, IRD-002).
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c: the NULL and double-free safety; the NULL payload round trip.

title: The consumer may change hands across a synchronisation
body: The consumer's role may pass from one thread to another when the second's first take is ordered after the first's last one by a synchronisation (a thread join), the consumer's position being plain memory owned by whichever thread is the consumer.
rationale: kyr_core's stop joins the writer and drains from the stopping thread (SSS-006).
criteria: An analysis of dequeue_pos: plain loads and stores, ordered by the join; no atomic is needed for a single owner at a time.

title: The ABI is gated
body: abi/layout.txt shall describe the public ABI of app/mpscring.h (eight functions and the constant MPSC_RING_MIN_CAPACITY); the shared object shall export exactly the eight declared functions as <name>@@MPSCRING_1; a changed line of the layout shall need a new major, a new public name a new minor.
rationale: A consumer built against another major fails at load, never at run time (IRD-005).
criteria: The pipeline's stages abi and abi-exports pass.

title: Two packages, reproducible
body: The library shall be delivered as libmpscring (the shared object and its soname link) and libmpscring-dev (the header, the static archive, the linker link), the second depending on the first at the same version, built to the same bytes from the same commit.
rationale: The platform pins both by SHA-256 (SSS-007).
criteria: The pipeline's stages package and package-smoke pass; the SHA256SUMS of the debs.

title: A hardened release
body: The release shared object shall pass kyr-build's hardening check: full RELRO, immediate binding, a non-executable stack, stack canaries, fortified calls, no RPATH, a versioned soname.
rationale: The ring sits on the path of every write of the box (SSS-007).
criteria: The pipeline's check_hardening on the release artifacts and its glibc-ceiling stage pass.

title: Nothing linked but the C library
body: At run time the library shall depend on the C library alone; deps.txt shall name only build and test tools.
rationale: Tier 1 of the platform: nothing under it (SSS-007).
criteria: Inspection of deps.txt and the shared object's NEEDED entries (the hardening check's allowlist).

title: Test seams never shipped
body: The allocation, lock-free, push-hook and position-stealing seams shall be compiled only with MPSC_RING_TESTING, in the coverage and sanitizer runs, and never in a shipped artifact; the release library shall export no test symbol.
rationale: The seams replace the allocator and fake a competing producer; a shipped seam would be a hook into every write of the box.
criteria: The release unit tests (9, the seams' 3 compiled out) link against the shipped library; abi-exports finds exactly the eight functions.

title: Verified under every profile that runs the suites
body: The unit suite shall pass against the release library; the unit and integration suites together shall cover 100 % of the lines and branches of app/mpscring.c; both shall pass under ASan, UBSan and LSan, the integration suite and a reduced stress under ThreadSanitizer, and the full stress (16 producers, 8,000,000 values) on the release archive.
rationale: The customer takes a release only with its concurrent paths run under the thread sanitizer (SSS-008).
criteria: The release pipeline at the release commit, the TSan stage enabled: every stage passed.

title: One consumer at a time
body: The caller guarantees that at any moment at most one thread pops or checks emptiness, and that a change of consumer is ordered by a synchronisation.
rationale: kyr_core's writer is the one consumer, the stopping thread after joining it (IRD-003, SSS-006).

title: Producers publish promptly
body: No producer blocks, sleeps or is cancelled between its claim and its publish; the platform cancels no thread and kyr_core's submitters hold no lock in the hand-off.
rationale: The window SRS-013 describes stays a few instructions of a running thread (SSS-005).

title: Creation and destruction while the ring is quiet
body: The caller creates and destroys a ring only while no thread uses it.
rationale: kyr_core creates the rings before it starts the writers and destroys them after the last drain.

title: A 64-bit target with lock-free 64-bit atomics
body: The library runs on a 64-bit target (x86-64, aarch64) whose 64-bit atomics are lock-free, with capacities far below 2^63.
rationale: The box's targets; SRS-014 refuses any other, SRS-016's comparison needs it.

title: MPSC_RING_MIN_CAPACITY
body: #define MPSC_RING_MIN_CAPACITY UINT64_C(2): the smallest capacity the per-slot sequence algorithm supports; part of the ABI (abi/layout.txt).
rationale: A caller validating its configuration needs the bound.
criteria: Inspection of app/mpscring.h against abi/layout.txt.

title: The ring handle
body: typedef struct mpsc_ring mpsc_ring_t: an opaque type, held by pointer; its layout is the library's.
rationale: Every call takes the handle; the consumer never sees the positions.
criteria: Inspection of app/mpscring.h against abi/layout.txt.

title: mpsc_ring_storage_size()
body: size_t mpsc_ring_storage_size(uint64_t capacity): the bytes mpsc_ring_init_into() needs, alignment slack included, or 0 for an invalid capacity. A function, not a constant expression.
rationale: How a caller sizes its own memory.
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c; tests/ITs/integration_tests.c.

title: mpsc_ring_init_into()
body: mpsc_ring_t* mpsc_ring_init_into(void* storage, size_t storage_size, uint64_t capacity): a ring inside the caller's storage, never allocating, or NULL for invalid arguments, undersized storage or a target without lock-free atomics; destroy frees nothing. Not thread-safe.
rationale: The caller-owned path.
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c.

title: mpsc_ring_init()
body: mpsc_ring_t* mpsc_ring_init(uint64_t capacity): a ring in storage the library allocates and owns, or NULL for an invalid capacity, a failed allocation or a target without lock-free atomics. Not thread-safe.
rationale: kyr_core's path.
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c.

title: mpsc_ring_push()
body: int mpsc_ring_push(mpsc_ring_t* ring, void* item): 0 when item is stored, -1 when the ring is full or NULL; safe from any number of concurrent producer threads; NULL is a storable item.
rationale: The submitters' hand-off.
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c; tests/ITs/integration_tests.c.

title: mpsc_ring_pop()
body: int mpsc_ring_pop(mpsc_ring_t* ring, void** out_item): 0 when a value is taken (written to *out_item unless out_item is NULL), -1 when the ring is empty or NULL; the single consumer thread only.
rationale: The writer's take.
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c; tests/ITs/integration_tests.c.

title: mpsc_ring_is_empty() and mpsc_ring_capacity()
body: int mpsc_ring_is_empty(mpsc_ring_t*): 1 when nothing is published at the consumer's next position (1 for NULL), the consumer thread only. uint64_t mpsc_ring_capacity(const mpsc_ring_t*): the fixed capacity, 0 for NULL, any thread.
rationale: The writer's check before it sleeps; a caller's sizing.
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c; tests/stress/stress_mt.c.

title: mpsc_ring_destroy()
body: void mpsc_ring_destroy(mpsc_ring_t** ring): free the storage when the library owns it (mpsc_ring_init), free nothing for mpsc_ring_init_into, and set *ring to NULL; NULL and a NULL *ring are no-ops. Not thread-safe.
rationale: The end of a ring's life.
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c.

title: Library linkage
body: libmpscring.so.1 (soname major 1) exports exactly the eight functions of app/mpscring.h as <name>@@MPSCRING_1 (utils/mpscring.map); libmpscring.a carries the same functions; a consumer includes <mpscring.h>.
rationale: A consumer built against another major fails at load.
criteria: The pipeline's abi and abi-exports stages; tests/package/smoke.c.

title: The packages
body: libmpscring_<version>_<arch>.deb: /usr/local/lib/libmpscring.so.<version> and its soname link; libmpscring-dev_<version>_<arch>.deb: /usr/local/include/mpscring.h, /usr/local/lib/libmpscring.a and the libmpscring.so link, depending on libmpscring (= <version>); both replace the former single package mpscring.
rationale: What the platform installs and pins.
criteria: utils/smoke_test_package.sh builds tests/package/smoke.c against the installed packages alone.

title: Build-time switches
body: MPSC_REQUIRE_ALWAYS_LOCK_FREE (the project's builds define it: a target without always-lock-free 64-bit atomics fails to compile); MPSC_CACHELINE (64 by default: the layout only, never the behaviour); MPSC_RING_TESTING (the test seams, never in a shipped build).
rationale: A consumer compiling the source must know what each switch changes.
criteria: Inspection of app/mpscring.c and utils/mpscring_project.sh.
